title: Stu: the rollout loop, generation by generation

opponent.label: Gen 8 card play
opponent.detail: 8p-32 with policy v4.1, the Gen 8 prototype's search. No net in the loop is trained on its games or on seed 131.

rungs.label: Net alone
rungs.text: The net alone: its first card at every trick; no search, no rollouts, no claims, no mixing (bots stu0-n, stu0v1-n; a net that takes names is told both sides are 8s-32)

rungs.label: Stu's own stages
rungs.text: Stu's own stages: search at the lead and tricks 1 to 2, blend at trust 0.25 at tricks 3 to 6, rollouts alone from trick 7

rungs.label: Blend 0.5
rungs.text: Stu with the blend at tricks 3 to 6 at trust 0.5

rungs.label: Rollouts from 6
rungs.text: Stu with rollouts alone from trick 6

rungs.label: Rollouts from 3
rungs.text: Stu with rollouts alone from trick 3

rungs.label: Pure Stu
rungs.text: The net's opening lead, rollouts alone from the second card on; no double dummy. The loop's main line from 11:25 UTC on 13 Nov (Max), with the single-dummy guarantee kept

rungs.label: Pure, searched lead
rungs.text: Pure Stu with a searched opening lead: the search decides the lead, rollouts alone from the second card on

rungs.label: Pure, rolled-out lead
rungs.text: Pure Stu with the opening lead from rollouts: every distinct lead on 512 layouts of the three hidden hands, none dropped; rollouts alone from the second card on. The collection's bot from 12:43 UTC (spr0)

nets.label: Rollout net v1 (ft)
nets.trained: policy v4.1 fine-tuned on the Gen 7+ bots' searched decisions, 512 wide

nets.label: Rollout net v2
nets.trained: every Gen 6-8 arena episode (about 66,000), every bot's decisions, a vector for each side's bot; 768 wide, 5 epochs from random weights

nets.label: Stu 1's net
nets.trained: v2 with one bot added, stu0, whose two vectors start from 8s-32's and are trained on 759 boards of round 0's Stu (62,504 decisions; --only-vectors stu0, rate 1e-2, epoch 6 of 8). Every other weight is v2's, bit for bit.
nets.note: Held-out rows: 250 later boards of Stu's (bot stu0) joined to freshB.npz (the other bots). v2 on the same rows from metrics_before.json (nothing trained).

rounds.label: Stu 0
rounds.note: x8's 8Z with rollout net v2 inside; the table net (the candidates' prior) is policy v4.1. Pure Stu is the main line from 11:25 UTC.

rounds.label: Stu 1
rounds.note: Round 1's net: v2 with Stu's two bot vectors trained on 759 of Stu 0's boards; every other weight is v2's (train-r1/README.md).

control.note: Rollouts from trick 7 against a net alone (README, Measured before round 0). R41 and R4: rollouts with v4.1 or v4 playing the simulated seats (table net v4.1 in both); N41, N4: v4.1 or v4 alone; F41, F4: the rollout bot built wholly on v4.1 or v4.

cautions: Seed 131 is the gate's and the ladder's and is never trained on. Seed 9001 is round 0's training seed: a run on a training seed says nothing about strength on fresh deals once a net has been trained on it.

New Stu against old Stu is not the gate. A net trained on a bot's games predicts that bot; in the control the inside net matching the opponent was worth +1.12 ± 0.16 IMPs a board by itself. The gate is the outside opponent.
Everything here is against one outside opponent, Gen 8 card play. Reference, same opponent and seed: x8's 8Z (the rung Stu with net v1) −0.38 ± 0.14 over 541 boards, with feature forks on.
Self-play IMPs are a check (one bot against itself), not strength. Data runs (a ladder bot against Stu on training deals) flatter Stu: a rollout bot is the opponent Stu's net models best.

s0 and r0 (round 0's first collection, Stu's own stages) played most boards identically in both rooms (two ids of one bot shared the room seeds): 113 of 119 boards of s0 card for card. Their distinct tables are about half their boards. From 12:37 UTC the collection plays one table a board.
